market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from US-Iran conflict, rate-hike expectations, and California utility regulatory shock. Expect volatility in oil, equities, and rates. Energy outperforms; tech and utilities under pressure. Dollar weakness adds FX noise. 10-year yield breakout is the key macro variable.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure spending remains a multi-year growth engine but faces valuation reckoning risk. Insurance consolidation (Aon/USI) and telecom oligopolies (Millicom) offer structural alpha. Geopolitical fragmentation (Venezuela, Iran, China/Taiwan) drives commodity and defense spending. Rate cycle likely peaks within 6 months, creating equity entry points. Apple leadership transition will reshape tech leadership.
